What's a padlet?
----------------

In its purest form, a padlet is a blank page. You can dress
it up or dress it down. From your hobby to your career, your
class notes to your final exam, your mood board to your runway
show, padlets help you organize your life.

Our Community
-------------

Collaboration is what makes Padlet special. We are beloved
in classrooms because every student has an equal voice. We are
instrumental to businesses because team projects are easily
managed and improved. From distant corners of the Earth,
individuals can connect on Padlet.
